atom: QG-35 existence/selection separation for TARE frame choice

criterion.statement: a predicate B on column types is decidable from a summary A iff B is a union of blocks of A's partition
criterion.why_it_is_decisive_here: A = bulk x spectrum has exactly 92 blocks, recomputed from main, so the question is settled by inspection of those blocks

explicit_witnesses.independent_verification: research/extensions/orion-qg/qg35_witness_independent_verify.py recomputes bulk, spectrum and the full 384-response from the primitives rather than reading any cache; IXIYXZ/IXIYYZ, IXXYYZ/IXXYZY and IXIXIY/IXIXYI all confirmed with 0 shared optimal frames
explicit_witnesses.property: same joint class (hence identical bulk AND identical spectrum), same optimal VALUE, different optimal FRAMES
explicit_witnesses.strongest: several pairs share ZERO optimal frames, so a compiler reading bulk+spectrum cannot select even one correct frame

provenance.note: the separation was found by exploration before this protocol was written; the committed scripts are replay instruments, not prospective discovery instruments, following the convention already used in this programme
provenance.primitives: recomputed from main; no unmerged PR is required

sharpens: QG-2's negative result, from 'no predicate in the frozen literal family is exact' to 'no predicate computable from bulk+spectrum exists, at any expressiveness'

part_a_existence_is_free.proof: the spectrum IS the sorted 384-response tuple, so any symmetric function of the responses factors through it
part_a_existence_is_free.statement: every function of the achievable-cost multiset is determined by bulk+spectrum
verified_instances: is an improvement of >= k available for k = -3..3
the full multiset of achievable costs

part_b_selection_is_impossible.statement: the optimal-frame set is NOT determined by bulk+spectrum

part_c_the_price.source: QG-34, D_* = 3, with a matching depth-2 infeasibility certificate on all 16 worst classes
part_c_the_price.statement: the residual costs exactly 3 adaptive indexed probes
part_c_the_price.sufficiency: cost is letter-S_3 invariant, so the 715 orbit types resolve selection completely; 646 distinct optimal-frame sets occur across them
